results.criterion: In GIS, with an available Surveyor layer loaded, the layer legend exposes Display Settings; opening Display Settings shows the Show linked sites checkbox with an identifiable initial checked or unchecked state.
steps_taken: Started at the launcher, opened GIS, selected the available Surveyor layer, and accepted its default configuration.
Opened Display Settings and observed Show linked sites checked.
results.reason: Display Settings exposed the checkbox with a clear checked initial state.

results.criterion: Selecting the Show linked sites checkbox changes its displayed state to the opposite checked or unchecked state.
steps_taken: Started from the launcher, opened GIS, loaded the available Surveyor layer, and opened Display Settings.
Observed the checkbox checked, selected it once, and observed it unchecked.
results.reason: The control changed from checked to unchecked after selection.

results.criterion: After closing and reopening Display Settings, the Show linked sites checkbox displays the changed state.
steps_taken: Started at the launcher, opened GIS, opened Display Settings, and recorded the checkbox as checked.
Selected the checkbox to change it to unchecked, closed Display Settings with Escape, and reopened Display Settings.
Observed the checkbox remained unchecked after reopening.
results.reason: The changed unchecked state was retained when Display Settings was reopened.

results.criterion: After restoring Show linked sites to its recorded initial state, closing and reopening Display Settings displays that original state.
steps_taken: Started at the launcher, opened GIS and Display Settings, and recorded the checkbox as checked.
Changed it to unchecked, restored it to checked, closed Display Settings with Escape, and reopened it.
Observed the original checked state after reopening.
results.reason: The original checked state remained visible after restoring, closing, and reopening Display Settings.
